entry.title: ClientIP affinity cannot own your login session
entry.summary: Service affinity routes by client IP. Test login continuity and revocation across replicas, IP changes, and Pod replacement.

entry.title: An Observable callback is not a background scheduler
entry.summary: Registering an observation callback does not make it run per request. Its timing follows the reader and collection path.

entry.title: Why toBeHidden does not prove a DOM node was removed
entry.summary: A hidden assertion accepts absence or nonvisibility. Match the assertion to the UI's removal contract.

entry.summary: Compare default null handling with MATCH FULL and choose a constraint that matches the optional relationship.

entry.title: Why a literal percent sign expands a PostgreSQL LIKE search
entry.summary: A bound search value can still contain LIKE wildcards. Escape literal input and test the resulting match set.

entry.title: Why ON CONFLICT can succeed while RETURNING yields no row
entry.summary: Trace insertion, conflict locking, the update condition, and the rows actually returned by PostgreSQL.

entry.title: Why two reads in one Read Committed transaction can differ
entry.summary: Follow two transactions to see how statement snapshots, own writes, and concurrent commits shape each read.

entry.title: Why a recovered metric can leave an alert firing
entry.summary: The alert may remain firing after its condition stops matching. Read the retention window and scrape health separately.

entry.title: When should pytest.importorskip fail instead of skipping?
entry.summary: Separate a missing optional module from a broken import and account for pytest's version-specific default.
